svg.text: Max put Max's bread down and went to
ask the neighbor for a drink. Pippin sat
Pippin took Max's bread and hid it
After that, Pippin looked up at the clouds for
a while. The clouds drifted slowly across the
Gray italic: prewritten text, reused across stories
Black: text generated for this specific story
A program collects stories, assigns names to roles, and inserts neutral filler text
